Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:145402
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 25398 of 2023

Applicant :- Durgesh Yadav
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Prem Shankar,Ashok Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Kripesh Mishra
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Prem Shankar, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Satyam Sharma, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri Kripesh Mishra, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Imran Khan, learned AGA, for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.198 of 2023, under Sections 376 and 506 IPC, Police Station Sahjanwa, District Gorakhpur during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged on 13.4.2023 against the applicant and two others under Sections 376 and 506 IPC and according to the FIR, applicant used to commit rape with the sister of informant aged about 22 years and on 19.2.2023 he after committing rape told her to fetch jewellery and money from her house and this time his sister informed about the atrocities of applicant to the informant.

entities.text: Durgesh Yadav vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and applicant neither ever outraged the modesty of the sister of informant nor he ever committed rape with her.

5. He further submits that actually informant and other persons assaulted the applicant and due to assault made by them applicant also sustained injuries and in this regard on 23.2.2023 brother of the applicant lodged FIR against them under Sections 323 and 308 IPC at Police Station Sahjanwa,
District Gorakhpur as Case Crime No. 100 of 2023 and only due to this enmity and to save skin from the FIR dated 23.2.2023 informant after about two months of alleged incident dated 19.2.2023 lodged FIR of the present case on 13.4.2023.
6.
He further submits that as there is delay in lodging the FIR of about two months, therefore, this inordinate delay itself shows that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present matter.

7. He further submits that applicant is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 29.4.2023.
8.
Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant although opposed the prayerfor bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. However, there is allegation of rape and sexual exploitation against the applicant in the FIR and statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and in the statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she also stated that applicant committed rape with her on 19.2.2023 but admittedly prosecutrix is a major girl aged about 22 years and FIR of the present case was lodged on 13.4.2023 after almost two months.

11. Further, from the perusal of Annexure-7 of the affidavit it appears that before lodgement of FIR of present case brother of applicant lodged FIR on 23.2.2023 against the informant and others under Sections 323 and 308 IPC with regard to the assault made by them upon applicant.

12. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant-Durgesh Yadav be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: ( i ) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
